content: Let the image of the point $$\left(\frac{5}{3}, \frac{5}{3}, \frac{8}{3}\right)$$ in the plane $$x-2 y+z-2=0$$ be P. If the distance of the point $$Q(6,-2, \alpha), \alpha > 0$$, from $$\mathrm{P}$$ is 13 , then $$\alpha$$ is equal to ___________.
